extracted.stage: Divorce proceedings, litigant in person, hearing listed
extracted.summary: Marcus is self-representing in a divorce where around £274k of assets (house and pension) are in dispute and asks to borrow about £25k for representation ahead of a 9 December hearing.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for contacting Lodestar Legal Finance about funding for your divorce proceedings. We have noted that you are currently representing yourself, that you are seeking around £25,000, and that there is a hearing listed for 9 December. To look at your enquiry further we would need confirmation of where the proceedings are taking place, details of the solicitor you intend to instruct and their likely costs, and information about the assets in dispute, including how the house and pension are held and any existing charges. If you can also tell us the stage the case has reached and whether any financial disclosure has been exchanged, that would help. A member of the team will be in touch once we have reviewed what you send.
